notes: Stdlib server on 127.0.0.1:8191 (Host and same-origin checked), started on demand by Start Studio.cmd or scripts/Start-Studio.ps1; not a resident service.

Host-bound: it drives a locally installed ComfyUI on 8188 and the Radeon GPU, and writes under experiments/ (workspace SQLite index, content-addressed store, runs). Models and outputs live outside Git by design.

Backup policy is none-needed on a documented basis, not a verified one: docs/OPERATIONS.md leaves backing up experiments/runs and ComfyUI input/output to the owner. There is no automated snapshot or restore drill, so a loss is tolerated and outputs are regenerated from the kept recipes.

/api/health reports build {sha, started_at}: the git HEAD read once at Studio start and the UTC start time, so an observer can tell a Studio running older code than its checkout. Only readiness is declared as a signal. /api/health asks ComfyUI for its stats and node schema, so the observer should poll it sparingly; online:false means ComfyUI is down, not the Studio.
Run from a checkout that sessions fast-forward, so a long-running Studio can be stale until restarted; restart only when no queued, running or partial Studio work exists.
